main.description: Deletes a thread's space. Messages members wrote in it stay in their own repos and become unreadable to everyone but their authors, the same way deleting a channel works. Messages that were moved into the thread go with it.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request has no valid service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks the thread.manage permission.

errors.name: ThreadNotFound
errors.description: No thread matches the given space reference.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.

errors.name: PdsUnavailable
errors.description: The community's PDS is unreachable or the AppView has no administrative access to it.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The community's PDS failed while deleting the thread's space.
